evidence.source: Ministry of Education, Taiwan, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.field: senses and source's lack of semantic chronology
evidence.text: The entry reports the Shuowen gloss of pregnancy and separately lists containing/wrapping, citing the Shijing line 白茅包之. It gives no dated semantic chain connecting those uses; the link between pregnancy and wrapping remains unresolved.
evidence.title: [A00408] 包 - 教育部《異體字字典》

evidence.source: Shuowen.org, received 說文解字 text with Duan Yucai commentary
evidence.text: Duan Yucai glosses 包 as pregnancy, says the inner shape represents an unformed child, interprets 勹 as enclosure and also as phonetic, then says the graph extended to denote wrapping generally. This is a Qing philological explanation of the received graph, not proof of a dated semantic transition.
evidence.title: 說文解字「包」 - Shuowen.org

evidence.field: seal-style glyph provenance and reuse rights
evidence.text: The file page identifies 包-seal.svg as an Inkscape-made vector in Shuowen seal-script style, identifies source references for the image, and states CC0 1.0/public-domain terms. The file history includes uploads from 2013 and 2018. It is a modern redraw, not an ancient artifact photograph or scan.
evidence.title: File:包-seal.svg - Wikimedia Commons

search_audit.query: 包 妊 白茅包之 语义演变 说文 字源; site:dict.variants.moe.edu.tw/dictView.jsp 包 妊 白茅包之; 包-seal.svg Wikimedia Commons CC0
search_audit.outcome: Search returned the Taiwan Ministry entry, Shuowen text with Duan commentary, and Commons file page. Opened and inspected all three. Ministry lists pregnancy and wrapping separately; Duan explicitly proposes extension to wrapping, but no dated chain was established. Commons confirms the glyph is a modern vector redraw under CC0.

gaps: No dated evidence establishes that the wrapping sense developed from the pregnancy sense; retain the senses separately and describe their historical relationship as unresolved.

The seal candidate is a modern redraw, not an artifact image; the file page points to source databases, but this research did not verify its correspondence to a dated artifact form or inspect its pixels. Downstream pixel review remains necessary.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; modern redraw, with file history entries from 2013 and 2018
items.tradition: Small seal-script style, rendered as a modern vector
items.caption: A modern vector redraw of 包 in Shuowen seal-script style. Shuowen interprets the received form as pregnancy, but this redraw does not establish the graph’s origin or a historical transition to the wrapping sense.
items.alt: A black seal-script-style 包 form with an inner curve enclosed by a larger outer stroke on a white background.
items.selection_reason: The file page identifies the script style, source references, and reuse terms. It can illustrate the received form associated with the Shuowen interpretation, while its modern-redraw status is made explicit.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication, as stated on the Commons file page.

limitations.text: This is a modern redraw, not an ancient artifact image. The pregnancy and wrapping senses are recorded separately, and the evidence inspected here does not establish their historical connection. No pixel inspection was performed.
